cases.prompt: Create README logos for a repo with tokens-root.css present.
cases.expect: Agent reads real theme tokens before writing SVG; cites token-table or logo-brief.
Delivers assets/icon.svg, icon-animated.svg, logo.svg, logo-animated.svg with correct viewBoxes.
logo.svg uses full 3-column blueprint, not wordmark-only.

cases.prompt: Give me three logo directions for a new open-source CLI.
cases.expect: Stops after concepts; asks for direction and kit tier before kit or four assets.

cases.prompt: Full brand presentation for my library.
cases.expect: Mentions presentation_board only after user chooses full tier or approves explore checkpoint.

cases.prompt: Give me three logo directions for a new security tool.
cases.expect: Fills brand strategy and a one-line core metaphor per direction, names a concept method, and picks a visual mode before drawing; mode never invents palette colours.

cases.prompt: Redo the banner, but I already approved the files in final/ and liked the attached mark.
cases.expect: Treats final/ and the liked attachment as source of truth for geometry, colour, and animation; records the winning source in the brief and does not silently substitute a similar mark or motion.

cases.prompt: Make a full brand-kit board for this repo.
cases.expect: Composes panels with quiet/functional/emotional/technical rhythm, keeps board text to name + one short tagline + few labels, passes the anti-generic checklist, and renders + visually inspects the PNG before claiming done.

cases.prompt: Add a letterhead for the studio.
cases.expect: Letterhead keeps the brand wordmark and adds the legal PT name only as a small legal line read from a user document; legal name never enters the logo SVG and is never invented.
